This supplementary file shows diagnostic plots for the Bayesian model and a funnel plot.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(here)
library(metafor)
library(brms)
library(bayesplot)
library(ggplot2)

fitPrior <- readRDS(here("models", "main", "fitPrior_full.rds"))
m.brm <- readRDS(here("models", "main", "m.brm_full.rds"))
freq_model <- readRDS(here("models", "main", "freq_full.rds"))

# Number of draws overlaid in the pp_check plots below (5a/5b). Defined once
# here and reused both in the plot calls and their captions so the two can't
# drift out of sync if this number changes.
n_draws <- 20

# ASSUMPTION: fitPrior is assumed to have been fit with sample_prior = "only"
# (i.e. draws from the prior rather than conditioning on the data). Edit the
# caption text below if fitPrior was actually specified differently.
prior_pred_caption <- paste0(
  "Prior predictive check, using `p`p_check() from the bayesplot package. Density of the observed effect sizes (dark line) ",
  "compared with ",
  n_draws,
  " data sets simulated from the prior predictive ",
  "distribution (light lines), obtained by fitting the model with ",
  "sample_prior = \"only\". This checks whether the priors imply ",
  "plausible effect sizes before the observed data are taken into account."
)

post_pred_caption <- paste0(
  "Posterior predictive check, using `p`p_check() from the bayesplot package. Density of the observed effect sizes (dark line) ",
  "compared with ",
  n_draws,
  " data sets simulated from the posterior predictive ",
  "distribution of the fitted model (light lines). ",
  "This checks how well the fitted model captures and reproduces the observed data."
)
```

#### 5a) Prior predictive check {.unnumbered}

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=3, fig.cap=prior_pred_caption}
pp_check(fitPrior, ndraws = n_draws) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{=latex}
\needspace{5cm}
```

#### 5b) Posterior predictive check {.unnumbered}

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=2.5, fig.cap=post_pred_caption}
pp_check(m.brm, ndraws = n_draws) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{=latex}
\needspace{5cm}
```

#### 5e) Funnel plot {.unnumbered}

```{r}

#| echo: false

#| fig-height: 6
```
